0.1.0.name: com.123cy321.nontoon-converter
0.1.0.description: lilToon -> NonToon material converter, shipped as a companion package to NonToon (Fork) so that the shader package stays a pure library. Generates NEW materials and never modifies the original lilToon materials. VRChat's PipelineManager is accessed through reflection, so this package has no VRChat SDK dependency and also works in non-VRChat projects.

0.2.0.name: com.123cy321.nontoon-converter
0.2.0.description: lilToon -> NonToon material converter, shipped as a companion package to NonToon (Fork) so that the shader package stays a pure library. Generates NEW materials and never modifies the original lilToon materials. VRChat's PipelineManager is accessed through reflection, so this package has no VRChat SDK dependency and also works in non-VRChat projects. 0.2.0 exploits this fork's extra capabilities: lilToon emission is copied 1:1 into the native Emission module (map / blend mask / main strength / blend mode), lilToon lighting adjustments (_AsUnlit / _LightMinLimit / _LightMaxLimit / _MonochromeLighting) are copied 1:1, and Shade Direction Bias is set to 0 so the shade follows the real light like lilToon. See Mapping.md for the full table and the after-conversion checklist.

0.3.0.name: com.123cy321.nontoon-converter
0.3.0.description: Tooling companion for NonToon (Fork): (1) the lilToon -> NonToon material converter, which generates NEW materials and never modifies the original lilToon materials, and (2) the SelfLight baker, which gives an avatar its own private light with a baked self-shadow map - no realtime Light component, so it does not affect the VRChat performance rank and never lights the world or other players. VRChat's PipelineManager is accessed through reflection, so this package has no VRChat SDK dependency and also works in non-VRChat projects. See Mapping.md (converter) and SelfLight.md (self light). Package id is historical (it started as the converter) and is kept so existing installs update in place.

0.3.1.name: com.123cy321.nontoon-converter
0.3.1.description: Tooling companion for NonToon (Fork): (1) the lilToon -> NonToon material converter, which generates NEW materials and never modifies the original lilToon materials, and (2) the SelfLight baker, which gives an avatar its own private light with a baked self-shadow map - no realtime Light component, so it does not affect the VRChat performance rank and never lights the world or other players. 0.3.1 adds self-diagnostics: the window now tells you explicitly when lilToon is not installed in the project (the converter reads lilToon materials as its source, so without lilToon nothing can be detected) and lists the actual shaders it saw when 0 materials are found. VRChat's PipelineManager is accessed through reflection, so this package has no VRChat SDK dependency and also works in non-VRChat projects. See Mapping.md (converter) and SelfLight.md (self light).

0.4.0.name: com.123cy321.nontoon-converter
0.4.0.description: Tooling companion for NonToon (Fork): (1) the lilToon -> NonToon material converter, which generates NEW materials and never modifies the original lilToon materials, and (2) the SelfLight baker, which gives an avatar its own private light with a baked self-shadow map - no realtime Light component, so it does not affect the VRChat performance rank and never lights the world or other players. 0.4.0 adds a full zh-Hans UI localisation layer (NTL10n + lang/zh-Hans.po, English fallback for any missing key), copies lilToon's per-pixel Shadow Strength/Border/Blur masks into NonToon's ShadowColor module, and exposes the SelfLight v2 PCSS controls (softness, density, clamp, shadow distance, receive mask) in the inspector. VRChat's PipelineManager is accessed through reflection, so this package has no VRChat SDK dependency and also works in non-VRChat projects. See Mapping.md (converter) and SelfLight.md (self light). Package id is historical (it started as the converter) and is kept so existing installs update in place.
